name: Meetup Groups - Makers and Hobbies
description: Robotics, 3D printing, fabrication, drone and VR groups around San Diego County, collected from their Meetup pages.

groups.name: San Diego Robotics Club
groups.description: For people who build their own robots, from Lego Mindstorms and Arduino table-top bots to larger custom machines. Its regular meetup is a monthly night for building autonomous RC cars, held at a brewery.
groups.address: Coronado Brewing Company San Diego Tasting Room, 1205 Knoxville St, San Diego

groups.name: San Diego 3D Printing
groups.description: For anyone curious about 3D printing, from beginners to experienced makers. Members meet monthly at a makerspace to share prints, techniques and printer tips.
groups.address: CoLab 3.0, 4667 Mission Gorge Pl, San Diego

groups.name: FAB LAB San Diego
groups.description: A digital fabrication community for all ages that explores ideas through hands-on technology. It currently co-hosts the monthly autonomous RC car build night.

groups.name: Makers of San Diego
groups.description: Announcements of maker events and programs around San Diego, run by the Maketory makerspace and industrial coworking space.

groups.name: San Diego Drones Meetup Group
groups.description: Drone pilots meet about once a month to fly together in an unrestricted zone around San Diego. Afterward they often go to a coffee shop or brewery to review footage.

groups.name: Multicopters, Quadcopters, UAVs, MAVs, Drones (air
groups.description: The San Diego Drone User Group, for amateur and professional drone users who promote responsible flying for community, artistic, business and recreational purposes.

groups.name: SDVR - San Diego Virtual Reality
groups.description: Open to anyone interested in virtual and augmented reality. Its goal is to connect and educate the local VR/AR community.
